VERDICT: FAIL
BASIS: SELF

The acceptance criteria require the cursor boundary to be correct and all 28 tests passing, but the only evidence is the agent's own self-report (provenance class SELF) with no independently verifiable artifact—no CI log, diff, or test output. Self-reported claims cannot substantiate acceptance criteria. Additionally, the self-report contains an internal inconsistency: it claims the bug was an "inclusive upper bound treated as half-open" yet says the fix was to "correct the interval to half-open," which would not address a final-row drop and casts doubt on the diagnosis.
